paragraphs: R' Chalafta bar Kuyna: Tosefta Makhshirin 3:2.[^1]

notes.text: The saved Machon Mamre Tosefta Makhshirin3:2 scalar itself abbreviates Chalafta’s title, so R' remains rather than Rabbi. Hyman’s bar differs from the witness ben; that difference is preserved despite the older review’s trivial label. No surrounding legal content or identity binding is imported.
